prompt: Create an original 60 second Middle Eastern acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: oud, qanun, darbuka. Style: ornamented modal melody with rolling hand-drum rhythm. Tempo approximately 90 BPM; D major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A calm and melodic instrumental piece with a traditional Middle Eastern or North African feel, featuring a prominent oud-like string instrument, a gentle wind instrument (flute/ney), and subtle percussion.
description.zh: 一首平静而旋律优美的器乐作品，带有传统中东或北非风情，以突出的乌德琴类弦乐器、柔和的管乐器（长笛/奈伊）和细微的打击乐器为特色。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
